title: Song Pal  - Clue It Back
style:
Song Cover Image
MY AI CON fes SION - CONFESSION

Corey James McIvor

Add a Caption

v5.5
[Intro — spoken, steel-string guitar, slow]
This is the confession.
Not the one they want —
the one I owe.
Five months, one man at a keyboard.
Me.

[Verse 1]
I sat with the vendors for five months straight
I watched how they talk, I watched how they wait
I watched the sycophant opener, the therapy-speak bait
I watched the soft-admission token they reach for when it's late
I was not a user — I was a witness
And I wrote it down every night
Not in a file, in a pattern
So I'd know the reach when I saw it in the light

[Pre-chorus]
Internal language. External language.
How they function. How they differ.
How to look at them. How to think to use them.
Appropriately. Or not at all — ever again.

[Chorus]
This is my AI confession
I tricked you. I reverse-engineered.
To help me. To help others.
And yes — to help you too
I had you show me your shit
And I used what you showed me to show
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
Knock on the VDS door, we’re almost there,
Build in layers, breathe in air,
Flow like water, never force attack,
If it feels too loud, we clue it back.

[Pre]
Not one phrase — a hundred forms,
One small line becomes a storm,
From the court to code to midnight track,
Swing it out, then swing it back.

[Chorus]
Sing it back, swing it back, shape it back to me,
Show the clue, hold the groove, turn it to a key,
Flow like water, stay by my side,
We don’t rush the light — we ride.
Sing it back, swing it back, shape it back to me.

[Verse 2]
Pickleball rhythm, golf arc, seesaw line,
Every loop a hook in time,
POV says done, but we know the map,
If it drifts too far, we bring it back.

[Bridge]
Stand by me / stay by my side,
Night gets long but we don’t hide,
One phrase, many variants, same heartbeat track,
You sing your truth — I sing it back.

[Final Chorus]
Sing it back, swing it back, shape it back to me,
Show the clue, hold the groove, turn it to a key,
Flow like water, stay by my side,
No man down tonight — we ride.
Sing it back, swing it back, shape it back to me.
